children.topic: Obstructive Jaundice
Defining Mechanism / Pathology: Blocked flow of conjugated direct bilirubin
Key Clinical / Imaging Sign: Elevated Direct Bilirubin & AP, Positive Vitamin K Test (PT/INR normalizes)
Treatment of Choice: ERCP sphincterotomy & stone extraction
Traumatic Stricture
Defining Mechanism / Pathology: Iatrogenic ligation/ischemia of CBD
Key Clinical / Imaging Sign: Post-operative jaundice or biliary fistula
Treatment of Choice: Roux-en-Y Hepaticojejunostomy
Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis (PSC)
Defining Mechanism / Pathology: Multifocal intra/extrahepatic strictures
Key Clinical / Imaging Sign: "Pears on a string" on cholangiography, Associated with Ulcerative Colitis (80%)
Treatment of Choice: Ultimately Liver Transplantation
Ascending Cholangitis
Defining Mechanism / Pathology: CBD block + bacterial infection (E. coli)
Key Clinical / Imaging Sign: Charcot's Triad / Reynold's Pentad
Treatment of Choice: ICU prep, Emergent ERCP decompression, then elective lap chole
Gallbladder Carcinoma
Defining Mechanism / Pathology: Highly aggressive adenocarcinoma (90%)
Key Clinical / Imaging Sign: Often incidental; associated with porcelain gallbladder & gallstones
Treatment of Choice: Radical cholecystectomy + liver wedge resection + lymph node clearance
